meaning.en: To decide that you want to obtain, achieve or do something very much.
meaning.zh: 一心想要得到某物、達成某個目標或做某件事；對某個目標抱有非常強烈的願望。
naturalZh: 一心想要得到某物、達成某個目標或做某件事
對某個目標抱有非常強烈的願望。

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; personal messages; stories; interviews; general workplace communication; informal and semi-formal writing.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬於中性用語，適合日常對話、私人訊息、故事、訪問、一般工作溝通及半正式文章。
register.formalEn: In highly formal reports, plain expressions such as strongly wishes to, is determined to or has made X the main goal may sometimes be clearer.
register.formalZh: 在非常正式的報告中，使用 strongly wishes to、is determined to 或 has made X the main goal 有時會更加清晰。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式一：一般限定動詞句
specificForms.formula: Subject + set(s) + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This is the core grammatical pattern.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這是最基本的句法框架。

examples.en: Sophie set her heart on the red bicycle.
examples.zh: 一心想要那輛紅色單車。

examples.en: Ethan sets his heart on difficult goals.
examples.zh: 經常把心思放在具挑戰性的目標上。

specificForms.formula: Subject + has/have + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern is especially useful when the desire began earlier and remains strong now.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式適合表示願望在較早前產生，而且現在仍然十分強烈。

examples.en: Grace has set her heart on studying in Edinburgh.
examples.zh: 一心想在愛丁堡讀書。

examples.en: The players have set their hearts on reaching the final.
examples.zh: 球員們一心想打入決賽。

specificForms.formula: Subject + had + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern is useful when the strong desire existed before another past event.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式適合表示強烈願望早於另一件過去事件出現。

examples.en: Daniel had set his heart on the corner flat.
examples.zh: 當時已一心想要那個角落單位。

specificForms.formula: Subject + may/might/could/will + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The modal verb preserves possibility, prediction or uncertainty. It is not part of the fixed idiom.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 情態動詞用來保留可能性、預測或不確定程度，並不是慣用語的固定部分。

examples.en: Priya may set her heart on studying abroad.
examples.zh: Priya 可能會一心想到外地讀書。

examples.en: You could set your heart on a course that is difficult to enter.
examples.zh: 你可能會一心想修讀一個很難入讀的課程。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式五：接於 seem 或 appear 後
specificForms.formula: Subject + seem/appear + to have set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern reports an impression rather than a confirmed fact.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式表示說話者的觀察或推測，而不是已確認的事實。

examples.en: She seems to have set her heart on moving to Vancouver.
examples.zh: 她似乎已一心想搬到溫哥華。

specificForms.formula: Subject + has/have not + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + has/have not + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + has/have not + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing。

examples.en: I have not set my heart on one particular laptop yet.
examples.zh: 我仍未一心認定要買某一部手提電腦。

examples.en: Do not set your heart on one house too soon.
examples.zh: 不要過早一心認定只買某一間房屋。

specificForms.formula: Have/Has + subject + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing?
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Have/Has + subject + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing?.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Have/Has + subject + set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + noun/-ing?。

examples.en: Have you set your heart on the London job?
examples.zh: 你是否已一心想得到倫敦的那份工作？

examples.en: Why has Ben set his heart on that flat?
examples.zh: 為甚麼一心想要那個單位？

specificForms.titleZh: 句式八：置於關係子句內
specificForms.formula: Noun + subject + had set + possessive + heart + on + verb...
specificForms.descriptionEn: Here, the desired object appears before the idiom because it is the head of the relative clause.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 在這個句式中，渴望得到的事物會出現在慣用語前面，因為它是關係子句所修飾的名詞。

examples.en: The course Alex had set his heart on was already full.
examples.zh: 一心想修讀的課程已經滿額。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式九：what 子句或分裂句
specificForms.formula: What + subject + had set + possessive + heart/hearts + on + was + goal.
specificForms.descriptionEn: These structures move the target expression away from one predictable sentence position.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些句式可以把慣用語放在不同位置，避免答案全部採用相同排列。

examples.en: What Hannah had set her heart on was singing at the school concert.
examples.zh: 一心想做的事，就是在學校音樂會上唱歌。

examples.en: It was a camera that Freya had set her heart on.
examples.zh: 一心想要的正是一部相機。

specificForms.titleEn: Inside a Time, Reason, Contrast or Condition Clause
specificForms.titleZh: 句式十：置於時間、原因、讓步或條件子句內
specificForms.descriptionEn: The opening clauses are optional grammatical extensions. The core idiom remains set one’s heart on.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 開首子句只是按語境加入的句法延伸； 核心慣用語仍然是 set one’s heart on。

examples.en: If you set your heart on the beach house, you will need to save for years.
examples.zh: 如果你一心想買那間海邊房屋，你便需要儲蓄多年。

examples.en: Although Lena had set her heart on the violin, she accepted that it was too expensive.
examples.zh: 雖然 Lena 一心想要那部小提琴，但她接受了它實在太昂貴。

examples.en: Since Kai has set his heart on representing the school, he practises every day.
examples.zh: 由於 Kai 一心想代表學校參賽，他每天都練習。

benefits.titleEn: It Expresses More Than an Ordinary Preference
benefits.en: The idiomatic version shows that this particular bicycle has become emotionally important to Sophie.
benefits.zh: 慣用語版本表示這輛特定的單車已經成為 Sophie 十分重視的目標。

benefits.titleEn: It Connects Desire with One Clear Goal
benefits.titleZh: 把強烈願望與特定目標連繫起來
benefits.en: a career; a journey; a personal achievement.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以清楚指出某人最想得到、做到或達成的特定目標。

benefits.titleEn: It Explains Refusal of Other Options
benefits.titleZh: 解釋為何拒絕其他選擇
benefits.en: The idiom explains why other choices no longer seem attractive.
benefits.zh: 一心認定要那個角落單位，因此拒絕考慮其他單位。 這個慣用語可以解釋為何其他選擇已無法吸引當事人。

examples.en: Daniel had set his heart on the corner flat, so he refused to view the others.
examples.zh: 一心認定要那個角落單位，因此拒絕考慮其他單位。

benefits.en: Because the desire was strong, the disappointing result becomes easier to understand.
benefits.zh: 一心想修讀的課程已經滿額。 由於原本的期望十分強烈，讀者便更容易理解當事人的失望。

examples.en: The course Alex had set his heart on was already full.
examples.zh: 一心想修讀的課程已經滿額。

benefits.titleEn: It Works in Several Sentence Positions
benefits.en: near the beginning; after an opening time phrase; inside a relative clause; inside a what-clause; inside a question; near the end of a longer sentence.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以自然地出現在多種句子位置，不需要每次都採用相同的主語開首句式。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Express Advice or Caution
benefits.en: This warns somebody not to become emotionally committed too early. Model Examples Sophie wants the red bicycle more than anything else. Ethan has decided that becoming a pilot is the only career he truly wants. The course Alex wanted more than all the others was already full.
benefits.zh: 在銀行批准貸款前，不要一心認定只買某一間房屋。 這種說法提醒別人不要過早在感情上投入一個仍未確定的結果。 Model Examples 示範例子 Model 1: Noun Complement 最想得到那輛紅色單車。 已一心認定要得到那輛紅色單車。 已決定，成為機師是他唯一真正想從事的職業。 已立志要成為機師。 最想修讀的課程已經滿額。 一心想修讀的課程已經滿額。

examples.en: Do not set your heart on one house before the bank approves the loan.
examples.zh: 在銀行批准貸款前，不要一心認定只買某一間房屋。

examples.en: Sophie has set her heart on the red bicycle.
examples.zh: 已一心認定要得到那輛紅色單車。

examples.en: Ethan has set his heart on becoming a pilot.
examples.zh: 已立志要成為機師。

examples.en: The course Alex had set his heart on was already full.
examples.zh: 一心想修讀的課程已經滿額。

origin.statusEn: Gradual Development; Exact First Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切首次用法不明

history.en: Today, the expression means fixing one’s strongest desire on a particular object, experience or achievement.
history.zh: 今天，這個表達表示把自己最強烈的願望集中在一個特定物件、經歷或目標上。

origin.memoryEn: When your heart is “set” in one direction, that goal has become the thing you want most.
origin.memoryZh: 當你的「心」被固定在一個方向時，那個目標便成為你最想得到或達成的事物。

rules.titleZh: 最想得到那輛紅色單車
rules.en: Sophie wants the red bicycle more than anything else. Sophie quite likes the red bicycle.
rules.zh: 最想得到那輛紅色單車。 頗喜歡那輛紅色單車。

rules.titleEn: Use an -ing Form for an Action
rules.en: Use an -ing Form for an Action

rules.titleEn: Do Not Add Determination That the Source Does Not Support
rules.en: Do Not Add Determination That the Source Does Not Support

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Same Meaning
rules.en: Do Not Repeat the Same Meaning

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Every Decision
rules.en: Do Not Use It for Every Decision
The expression can sometimes refer to romantic desire, but this exercise teaches only goals, possessions, experiences, courses and careers.
rules.zh: 本練習只教授與目標、物件、經歷、課程及職業有關的用法，不包括感情關係的語境。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with “Set Your Mind On”
rules.en: Do Not Confuse It with “Set Your Mind On”
